answer: Reputation-Weighted Task Routing. Each identity's task eligibility grows through a trellis of verified past completions, and rewards route only to identities with a matching history. Cloning yields near-zero expected income, since fresh identities receive only low-value audit work until they accumulate real records. An attacker therefore pays the full compute and delay cost of legitimate participation once per clone, with no shortcut. Auditors cross-check randomly assigned quartz-signed work logs, and disputed results forfeit accumulated standing plus a copper-denominated penalty.
